say.text: Damascus, a few days after the gate was opened. Ayyub's house is quiet again.
Father, I did not hesitate at the gate.
I saw you reach it. Courage is the easy half, Yusuf. When the gate was open, what did you see Nur ad-Din do?
Nur ad-Din entered the city and pledged the lives and the property of its people.
He gave his word that no one in the city would be harmed.
A prince's word is worth what he does with it the next morning. Watch that. It is the part of this day that is worth learning.
Salah ad-Din was raised under his father's care, and now entered the service of Nur ad-Din, who advanced him and made him one of his friends.
Will you come with me to his court?
I have served in more courts than I can count, and found that the best of them are schools. Go to learn, not to be seen.
